title: Methi Murgh Malai
mapper_verdict: REJECTED - unmappable without guessing; every label-accurate basis consistent with estate canon computes BELOW the run's 400-calorie floor

rejection_evidence.summary: Three independent problems compound: (1) the dairy backbone ('single cream', 300 ml across 6 servings) has no US retail equivalent on the board - USDA light cream (the honest single-cream basis, verified 2026-08-16: 197 cal / 3.0 P / 3.7 C / 19.1 F per 100 g) is not a board commodity, and the two carried neighbors bracket the calorie floor: booking half-and-half computes the dish to ~306 cal/serving and heavy cream to ~405, so the MAPPER'S product choice - not the recipe - would decide whether the recipe passes the 400 floor, which is exactly the adjust-to-fit sin the run brief forbids; (2) on the honest bases the recipe computes ~335 cal/serving, 16% below the floor: 1 kg bone-in 'curry cut' chicken rebuilt per the estate's standing skinless canon (burmese ruling, 70% yield -> 700 g BSCT = 117 g/serving = 146 cal) + 50 g light cream (98) + 7 g butter (50) + 17 g hung curd (12) + 55 g onion (22) + pastes/spices (~7) = ~335 cal / 26.6 P / 8.5 C; even the most generous defensible reading (boneless interpretation of 'curry cut', 167 g/serving) reaches only ~395; (3) the source's published nutrition cannot arbitrate any of it because it is internally impossible - 52.3 g protein per serving from at most 167 g of raw bone-in chicken per serving is unreachable (ceiling ~33 P even if the kilo were all boneless meat), and the stated 150 g serving size is inconsistent with the recipe's own ~267 g/serving cooked mass (1.6 kg batch across 6). The only paths into the band are guesses AGAINST the printed recipe: booking skin-on macros on a cut Bengali curry preparation customarily skins, or silently upgrading single cream to heavy whipping cream (+70 cal/serving). REFUSAL beats guessing.

computed_per_serving_honest_basis.note: skinless-canon chicken + USDA light cream; spread across all defensible bases 306-475, with every non-guess reading below 400

rejection_evidence.band_check: FAIL floor: ~335 cal vs the 400 minimum (-16%); carbs pass trivially (~8.5 g) but the floor miss is structural - the dish is a light 6-serving curry, not a 400+ cal dinner plate, and its own (impossible) label only claims 418
rejection_evidence.source_macro_status: UNRELIABLE: published 418 cal / 52.3 P / 11.6 C / 17.2 F per '150 g serving' is internally impossible against the printed ingredient list (protein ceiling ~33 P/serving; fat from cream+butter alone exceeds 17.2 on any cream reading heavier than half-and-half); the protein instrument cannot be used on this source

carriage_notes_not_ruled: Carriage was NOT ruled on and no terms were enqueued - a rejected recipe must not spend the singleton pricer's store time. For the record, the board answers observed from disk: kasuri methi / dried fenugreek leaves / fenugreek all ABSENT (no commodity, no capture - the dish's namesake herb would have been a blocking enqueue had the recipe survived); light cream not a commodity; hung curd would book to Greek Yogurt / Plain Yogurt (greek-yogurt, carried); garlic paste and ginger paste resolve to the fresh garlic / fresh-ginger commodities (carried); butter, onions, salt, black pepper all carried 7 of 7. Per Rule B nothing here is a carriage rejection - the rejection is macro-structural, not availability.
